description: Teach the call's speech recognition words it keeps mishearing (product names, people, jargon). Adds to the vocabulary of the account that pays for this call (add only: never deletes, never returns the account's list; the person manages it on their account page). terms: words to recognize; fixes: {wrong, right} = a known mishearing and the correct word (right is added to the terms too). Max 20 entries per call of this tool, 100 per call, 50 characters each. Corrections apply right away, the word list from the next sentence or the next call. 409: guest call without an account. Returns added {terms, fixes}, total, call_left, reloaded.

terms.description: Words or short phrases to recognize, e.g. ["Trello"].
terms.title: Terms

name: add_vocab
title: Add vocabulary for speech recognition
